kind.description: pick one kind when several share the name: security-rule or an object kind

device.description: the devices to read; left out, every device

vsys.description: the vsys to read; left out, every vsys

at.description: read each device's newest snapshot at or before this time; left out, the latest

detail.description: summary or full: how much of each result to return; summary when left out

limit.description: keep only the first N results, in the answer's usual order: findings for search, cards for lookup, single changes for snapshot_diff; the summary's omitted counts the rest. No default: left out, every result is returned
